description: This file defines a PHP class 'ReportingMethodConfigurationModel' used as a data model in the OrangeHRM system, specifically for representing configuration of reporting methods in the PIM (Personal Information Management) API module. It implements serialization features and is constructed with an entity of type 'ReportingMethod'.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationModel
classes.description: A model class used to serialize and expose ReportingMethod entity data in API responses within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a ReportingMethod entity and sets filters for serialization.
